purpose: Form SH-7 serves as a notice to the Registrar of any alteration of share capital. However, filing is restricted if a company fails to comply with Nidhi rules.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Verify compliance with Nidhi rules and rule 3A requirements.
Ensure the application in Form NDH-4 is approved and not rejected by the Central Government.
Proceed to file Form SH-7 with the Registrar if all Nidhi compliance requirements are met.
checklist: Check if the company has complied with the requirements of rule 3A.
Confirm that the Form NDH-4 application has not been rejected by the Central Government.
Verify that the company is allowed to file Form No. SH-7.
watch: A company that has not complied with rule requirements or whose Form NDH-4 has been rejected shall not be allowed to file Form No. SH-7.
